entities.name: Ogan Shieldmender
entities.description: Abzan Chief of the Scale in Tarkir's original timeline; a krumar originally of the Mardu clan, taken in by the Abzan.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: Tarkir clan whose patrol Ogan served in.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: Clan whose horde ravaged a shepherds' camp and converged on the canyon.

entities.name: Riza
entities.description: Leader of the Abzan patrol on the Salt Road.

entities.name: Salt Road
entities.description: Route along which the Abzan patrol marched.

entities.name: Canyon Falls
entities.description: Oasis where the Abzan fell back to make a defense.

events.summary: Riza's patrol found a shepherds' summer camp burned by Mardu with no survivors.
events.quote: ravaged and burned to the ground by Mardu

events.summary: Riza ordered a fall back to the oasis at Canyon Falls to await the larger patrol.
events.quote: Riza announced that they would fall back to the oasis at Canyon Falls

events.summary: Riza had Ogan array his men at the canyon mouth in a shield wall.
events.quote: Riza bid Ogan to array his men at the mouth of the canyon and form a shield wall

events.summary: The larger Abzan patrol arrived with a siege elephant as the Mardu converged.

relations.quote: Ogan Shieldmender was an Abzan Chief of the Scale
Ogan Shieldmender was part of a patrol led by Riza
